scope: All 32 exact G4 natural profiles; conditional alternatives for future bounded selection, not current presence or a finite resource

weight_policy.meaning: Relative game selection preference among eligible alternatives within one layer and exact G4; not archaeological frequency, biological abundance, encounter probability or yield

era_filter: Medieval Novgorod archaeology is regional compatibility only. Contemporary Valdai/European ecology is marked analogical; it is never a direct 1230 Lower Dvina occurrence. No exact G4 taxon, animal sighting, trace, sound, harvest, ownership, edible state or stock follows from this candidate.
season_policy: Use actual world date and phenology before selection. Winter leafless deciduous trees remain trees; fruit, flowers, fresh stems and visible animals require separate current-state support. No fixed month or guaranteed seasonal occurrence is asserted.
layer_gate: A candidate is eligible only where its exact G4 natural baseline layer is present; a missing fauna layer remains an approval gap. Fungi additionally require an organic substrate in that exact G4 ambient materials and describe substrate ecology only, never a visible or harvestable fruiting body. At driftwood_bar and shifting_shoal_field riparian_vegetation is not_applicable.
